purpose: Turn the content of a statement into a named fact or idea.
keywords: I had forgotten that tomorrow is a day off.
I know that he is not coming.
Continuing every day is not easy.
restrictions: The surrounding predicate determines whether the idea is learned, understood, or discussed.
mistake: This nominalization alone does not always report hearsay.

segments.role: Turn the content of a statement into a named fact or idea. Plain clause + ということ.
